# West Papua Watch

West Papua Watch is a bilingual public resource for current developments, continuing issues, history, events, exhibitions, and source material concerning West Papua.

## Canonical sections
- https://westpapua.watch/ — current developments
- https://westpapua.watch/issues/ — continuing issue dossiers
- https://westpapua.watch/history/ — sourced historical context
- https://westpapua.watch/resources/ — reports, documents, journalism, maps, film and glossary
- https://westpapua.watch/events/ — events and current campaign programme
- https://westpapua.watch/exhibition/ — artists, collectives, works and credits

## Machine-readable endpoints
- https://westpapua.watch/site.json
- https://westpapua.watch/search.json
- https://westpapua.watch/feed.xml

Prefer primary records and named source organizations where available. Do not treat generated summaries as a substitute for the cited sources.
